definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry occurs when a person employs primary human eye care procedures, including: the examination, diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions and diseases of the eye, its adnexa and visual system; measuring the powers and range of vision of the eye to determine the accommodative and refractive state and general function of the eye; the adaptation, sale, prescribing and dispensing of frames and ophthalmic lenses in all their forms; ordering and performance of diagnostic laboratory or imaging tests; the prescribing and administration of pharmaceutical agents, as provided in W.S. 33-23-102; preoperative and postoperative care for those procedures excluded from the practice of optometry; any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules and not excluded.

methods_authorized.quote: The practice of optometry occurs when a person employs primary human eye care procedures, including: (i) The examination, diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions and diseases of the eye, its adnexa and visual system; (ii) Measuring the powers and range of vision of the eye to determine the accommodative and refractive state and general function of the eye; (iii) The adaptation, sale, prescribing and dispensing of frames and ophthalmic lenses in all their forms; (iv) Ordering and performance of diagnostic laboratory or imaging tests; (v) The prescribing and administration of pharmaceutical agents, as provided in W.S. 33-23-102; (vi) Preoperative and postoperative care for those procedures excluded from the practice of optometry under subsection (c) of this section; (vii) Any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules and not excluded under subsection (c) of this section.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease, excluding schedule I and II narcotics, but allowing for the prescribing of hydrocodone or hydrocodone containing pharmaceutical agents regardless of schedule.
drug_authority.quote: An optometrist shall be allowed to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease, excluding schedule I and II narcotics, but allowing for the prescribing of hydrocodone or hydrocodone containing pharmaceutical agents regardless of schedule.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The following ophthalmic procedures shall be excluded from the authorized practice of optometry: (i) The following general procedures: (A) Administration of general anesthesia; (B) Surgery performed with general anesthesia.

surgery_definition.value: Excluded surgical procedures include surgery with general anesthesia, removal of an eye, surgery of the bony orbit, incisional/excisional surgery of extraocular muscles, eyelid surgery for malignancies or cosmetic/mechanical repair, incisional surgery of lacrimal system (other than probing), full thickness conjunctivoplasty with graft/flap, pterygium surgery, full thickness incision/excision of cornea/sclera (other than emergency paracentesis), corneal transplants, incision of iris or ciliary body, surgical extraction of crystalline lens, intraocular implants, vitreous removal, vitreous chamber procedures for retinal/macular disease including intravitreal injection, retinal manipulation, and intravenous injections.
surgery_definition.quote: The following nonlaser procedures: (A) Surgery related to removal of an eye from a living person; (B) Surgery of the bony orbit, including orbital implants; (C) Incisional or excisional surgery of the extraocular muscles; (D) Surgery of the eyelid for suspected malignancies or for incisional cosmetic or mechanical repair of blepharochalasis, ptosis or tarsorrhaphy
